# TravelDoss

> Plan trips in a Google Doc and see them on a live, day-by-day map. TravelDoss turns your doc into a pinned, categorized, routed itinerary inside an editorial dossier microsite.

TravelDoss is a trip-planning tool that pairs Google Docs with Google Maps. You pick a "skin" (an editorial dossier template), write or paste your trip into a Google Doc, and TravelDoss extracts every place — lodging, food, sights, transport — and pins them on a live, routed map organized by day. Each trip lives at its own private URL for a month for $1.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What TravelDoss is and how it turns a Google Doc into a live map.
- [Skins](/templates): The gallery of editorial dossier designs to choose from.
- [Google Docs travel itinerary template guide](/guide/google-docs-travel-itinerary-template): How to structure a trip itinerary in Google Docs and turn it into a live map.
